title: Google Maps Usage
takeaway: 88% of people use Google Maps to find local businesses.

data.label: Google Maps Usage
data.evidence: According to a 2024 study, 88% of people use Google Maps to find local businesses, highlighting the critical importance of optimizing your presence.

narration: Google Maps is a powerful tool for local businesses. A recent study revealed that a significant majority of consumers – 88% – utilize Google Maps to discover nearby businesses. This underscores the crucial need for businesses to optimize their online presence within Google Maps to capture a larger share of local search traffic.
